gen-fs-oswald-gf-line-seed-jp: Oswald stands tall and tightly knit, all confidence. LINE Seed JP answers it with strokes of uniform thickness and counters that let the eye slip right through, which is the real charm here.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-newa: Tight, strong, and sure of itself up top. Noto Sans Newa takes over below with a tall lowercase and a clearly open e, giving Oswald's compact rows a taller, looser partner.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-port-lligat-slab: Port Lligat Slab reads literary, with wide round counters like portholes. Shrink Oswald down and its tight, confident rows lose their punch, while the slab's hugging letters would still hold up if enlarged.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-quando: Bookish in spirit, this pairing starts with a heading that is confident and compact. Quando follows with sparse, widely spaced letters and a big middle zone, so Oswald delivers the punch and the serif delivers the room.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-savate: Oswald packs its heading into tight, strong rows with a low, restrained thick-thin ratio, set against Savate's taller, sturdier hairlines. The two differ most in height, and that gap does the work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sour-gummy: Tight and bold above, loose and crisp below. Sour Gummy keeps wide gaps between its letters, so a long page of it would read cleanly even at tiny sizes beside Oswald's compact lines.
gen-fs-oswald-nunito-sans: Nunito Sans has open-mouthed curves in its small letters that give it a soft, easy manner beside Oswald's confident heading. Long paragraphs would move along gently.
gen-fs-oswald-outfit: Approachable describes Outfit, whose curves finish well before they close. Oswald is best at packing confident, tight rows, while Outfit does its best work with strokes bent like cable at one width.
gen-fs-oswald-sora: Oswald crowds its letters together into a strong display heading, while Sora's uppercase is built from lines of one constant thickness. A long page of Sora would feel precise.
gen-fs-oswald-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk builds each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, with counters open like a hollow reed, against Oswald's tight, strong rows. That wire-like body against a dense heading is its best quality.
